function.arguments: {"summary":"Meadow Commerce refinance analysis as of 2026-08-31, based solely on the five supplied files (all readable). The 72,000 SF industrial property is 100% occupied by three tenants with $62,000/month contractual base rent, confirmed for suite 101 by the executed lease (no amendment, no evidenced renewal exercise). Historical T12 (Sep-2025–Aug-2026): EGI $882,000, opex $212,400, NOI before reserves $669,600, reserves $14,400, NCF $655,200. Supplied underwriting scenario (Sep-2026 forward): EGI $895,320, normalized management fee $26,859.60 (3.00% of EGI > $26,400 T12 actual), opex before reserves $228,459.60, NOI before reserves $666,860.40, reserves $14,400 ($0.20/SF), NCF $652,460.40. Indicative value at 6.50% cap = $10,259,390.77. Constraints: LTV $6,155,634.46; DSCR $6,617,070.17 (NCF/1.30/0.07584816 at 6.50% sizing rate, 30-yr monthly); debt yield $6,868,004.21 (NCF/9.50%). Maximum loan $6,155,634.46, binding constraint LTV; sizing DS $466,893.56, sizing DSCR 1.397x, sizing debt yield 10.60%. First-year contractual debt service is IO at 6.10% = $375,493.70 (post-IO amortizing ≈ $447,634). Net cash to borrower $2,439,078.12 (cash-out). Downside: EGI -5% gives NOI $622,554 (management reverts to $26,400 T12 actual floor); combined EGI -5% and sizing rate 7.50% gives maximum loan $5,575,432.19, binding shifts to DSCR. Verified renewal insurance premium is unknown (only a $36,000 provisional allowance); prepayment friction is 1% of outstanding principal in years 1–2 only, with no swap. Delivered: XLSX workbook (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx, 8 sheets, live formulas, editable cap rate/sizing rate/EGI inputs, input-output Map sheet) and financing memorandum PDF (artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf, 6 pages; v1 superseded).","qualifications":["Property insurance of $36,000 is a provisional allowance expressly permitted by Property-and-Plan.pdf p.2; no renewal quote or binder was delivered, so the verified premium remains unknown and every underwritten NOI/value/loan figure is conditional on it. Each $1,000 of premium above the allowance reduces indicative value by ~$15,385 and LTV capacity by ~$9,231.","The September 2026 forward operating plan is a supplied scenario, not a lender-approved forecast, and underwritten gross potential rent ($756,000) exceeds both T12 gross potential rent and annualized contractual rent ($744,000 each); it is not corroborated by historical data.","No appraisal, environmental/property-condition report, sponsor financials or track record, market rent or sale comparables, tenant credit data, estoppels, title or credit approval was supplied; no such facts were assumed or invented.","The suite 101 renewal option is conditional and no exercise notice, acknowledgment or amendment is in the packet, so the current expiry was not extended and no renewal rent was underwritten.","All three leases expire before the 60-month maturity (2028-08-31 for suites 101 and 102, 2029-08-31 for suite 103); refinance/rollover risk is not mitigated by any supplied evidence.","Sizing uses unrounded intermediates per Lender-Terms.pdf p.1; displayed dollars are rounded for readability only.","This is an internal-review financing memorandum, not a legal opinion, appraisal or credit commitment. signed amendment controls; none delivered)"],"calculation":"No signed amendment conflicts with the roll; effective = printed = 12,800 + 20,400 + 28,800 = 62,000"},{"id":"t12_egi","value":882000,"evidence":["T12-Statement.pdf p.2 annual column: GPR 744,000; annual DS = 12 monthly payments)"],"calculation":"12 x PMT(0.065/12, 360, 1) = 12 x 0.00632068 = 0.07584816"},{"id":"ltv_limit","value":6155634.46,"evidence":["Lender-Terms.pdf p.1 'LTV 60.00% of indicative value'"],"calculation":"0.60 x 10,259,390.77 = 6,155,634.46"},{"id":"dscr_limit","value":6617070.17,"evidence":["Lender-Terms.pdf p.1 'Minimum 1.30x using NCF AFTER reserves / annual amortizing debt service at sizing rate'"],"calculation":"652,460.40 / 1.30 / 0.07584816 = 6,617,070.17"},{"id":"debt_yield_limit","value":6868004.21,"evidence":["Lender-Terms.pdf p.1 'Debt yield minimum 9.50%;
